title: RX UNITY Script Hub
features:
# What is RX-UNITY?
————————————
• RX-UNITY is a script hub designed to display scripts from various sources for in-game use, offering powerful features to enhance your Roblox experience. These features include:

Executor Page
• An in-game script executor with a user-friendly UI. Note: This is not a downloadable executor; it runs directly within the game.

Game Info Page
• Displays detailed server information, including script uptime, user playtime, ping, FPS, server JobID, and server player count.

Game Settings Page
• Allows customization of your character such as speed, jump power, field of view (FOV), and gravity. Includes features like noclip and ESP (Extra Sensory Perception).

Music Page
• A playlist of working audio IDs, featuring a stop button, play button, next button, and a music visualizer for an immersive experience.

UI Settings Page
• Offers customization options to choose different styles and themes for the RX-UNITY user interface.

Chat Logger Page
• Logs all in-game chat messages, useful for games that restrict or block public chat visibility.

In-Game Chat Commands
• Detailed information about available commands is provided in the Info Page.

You can get the key from our discord server!
